name: Disable Transmog hides transmogs from the player who disabled it (#9030)
contract: CMSG 1699 carries the wardrobe's item and spell transmog switches (u8 item, u8 spell). The item switch
decides what its sender sees: with it off, other players' visible items are sent to that viewer as the
items they actually wear, while every other viewer and the wearer keep the transmog. The wearer equips
Apprentice's Robe 56 and applies Appearances.dbc row 6720 (chest, SourceItem Neophyte's Robe 6098),
collected through CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog. sent_visible_item reads the PLAYER_VISIBLE_ITEM
entry each session last received in a values update; rendering itself is not observed.

steps.label: The viewer turns item transmogs off
SETUP: the wearer wears Apprentice's Robe
SETUP: the chest transmog is accepted
SETUP: the wearer's visible chest is Neophyte's Robe
CONTROL: the wearer is sent the transmog
CONTROL: a bystander with transmogs on is sent the transmog
The viewer with transmogs off is sent the worn Apprentice's Robe
The viewer turns item transmogs back on
Turning transmogs back on resends the transmog without a relog
The wearer turns item transmogs off
The wearer then sees their own worn Apprentice's Robe
The wearer's own switch keeps the transmog for everyone else
The viewer is still sent the wearer's transmog
